name: Bitcoin
description: Bitcoin words a wallet conversation uses.

terms.summary: The money this wallet holds.
terms.definition: The money this wallet holds. One bitcoin is 100 million sats.

terms.summary: The unit this wallet speaks in: one hundred-millionth of a bitcoin.
terms.definition: The unit this wallet speaks in: one hundred-millionth of a bitcoin.

terms.summary: The ticker for bitcoin.
terms.definition: The ticker for bitcoin. 1 BTC is 100,000,000 sats.

terms.summary: Recorded in a bitcoin block.
terms.definition: Recorded in a bitcoin block. On-chain payments are final once confirmed, but slower and costlier than Ark or Lightning.

terms.summary: Held or paid without a transaction in a block, as on Ark and Lightning.
terms.definition: Held or paid without a transaction in a block, as on Ark and Lightning.

terms.summary: An unspent transaction output: one coin in bitcoin's ledger.
terms.definition: An unspent transaction output: one coin in bitcoin's ledger. A VTXO is Ark's virtual version of one.

terms.summary: A transaction's ID, a 64-character hash.
terms.definition: A transaction's ID, a 64-character hash. Never read one aloud: say its last four characters.

terms.summary: A block that includes a transaction (and each block after it).
terms.definition: A block that includes a transaction (and each block after it). More confirmations, more final.

terms.summary: How many blocks the chain has.
terms.definition: How many blocks the chain has. VTXO expiries are block heights; a block comes about every 10 minutes.

terms.summary: Where unconfirmed transactions wait to be mined.
terms.definition: Where unconfirmed transactions wait to be mined.

terms.summary: What a transaction pays per unit of size, in sats per virtual byte (sat/vB).
terms.definition: What a transaction pays per unit of size, in sats per virtual byte (sat/vB). Higher confirms sooner.

terms.summary: A test bitcoin network with worthless coins.
terms.definition: A test bitcoin network with worthless coins. Second runs a signet Ark server for trying Bark.

terms.summary: The real bitcoin network, with real money.
terms.definition: The real bitcoin network, with real money.

terms.summary: A private bitcoin network for development, where you mine blocks yourself.
terms.definition: A private bitcoin network for development, where you mine blocks yourself.

terms.summary: A block explorer API.
terms.definition: A block explorer API. Bark can read the chain through one instead of running Bitcoin Core.

terms.summary: The reference bitcoin node software; bitcoind is its daemon.
terms.definition: The reference bitcoin node software; bitcoind is its daemon.

terms.summary: The 12 words that back up a wallet: whoever has them has the money.
terms.definition: The 12 words that back up a wallet: whoever has them has the money. bark-voice never reads or shows them.

terms.summary: A partially signed bitcoin transaction, passed between signers until it's complete.
terms.definition: A partially signed bitcoin transaction, passed between signers until it's complete.

terms.summary: Bitcoin's 2021 upgrade: Schnorr signatures and script trees.
terms.definition: Bitcoin's 2021 upgrade: Schnorr signatures and script trees. Ark's transactions use it.

terms.summary: A way for several keys to make one Schnorr signature.
terms.definition: A way for several keys to make one Schnorr signature. Ark users and the server co-sign with it.

terms.summary: The signature scheme taproot brought to bitcoin.
terms.definition: The signature scheme taproot brought to bitcoin.

terms.summary: A rule that coins can't move until a time or block height.
terms.definition: A rule that coins can't move until a time or block height. Ark's exits and expiries rest on them.

terms.summary: CheckSequenceVerify: a relative timelock, counted from when a coin confirmed.
terms.definition: CheckSequenceVerify: a relative timelock, counted from when a coin confirmed.

terms.summary: CheckLockTimeVerify: an absolute timelock, at a fixed height or time.
terms.definition: CheckLockTimeVerify: an absolute timelock, at a fixed height or time.

terms.summary: Child pays for parent: spending a stuck transaction's output with a high fee so miners take both.
terms.definition: Child pays for parent: spending a stuck transaction's output with a high fee so miners take both.

terms.summary: Replace-by-fee: re-sending an unconfirmed transaction with a higher fee.
terms.definition: Replace-by-fee: re-sending an unconfirmed transaction with a higher fee.

terms.summary: Coins that need signatures from several keys to move.
terms.definition: Coins that need signatures from several keys to move.

terms.summary: A rule on where coins can go next, not only who can spend them.
terms.definition: A rule on where coins can go next, not only who can spend them. clArk works without one.

terms.summary: A payment where sender and receiver both add inputs, which breaks the usual chain-analysis guesses.
terms.definition: A payment where sender and receiver both add inputs, which breaks the usual chain-analysis guesses.

terms.summary: The bitcoin: payment link format.
terms.definition: The bitcoin: payment link format. One link can carry an on-chain address, an Ark address and a Lightning invoice.

terms.summary: Only you can move your bitcoin.
terms.definition: Only you can move your bitcoin. On Ark that holds because you can always exit on your own.
